Reference / runtime/environment

runtime/environment#

The native layer under os/environment: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under os/environment: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Public API#

native environment_snapshot#

native environment_snapshot() is %string:string

Portable immutable environment boundary used by os/environment.

native environment_normalize#

native environment_normalize(values is %string:string) is %string:string

values with names normalized for the host.

native environment_add#

native environment_add(values is %string:string, name is string, value is string) is %string:string

values with name set to value.

native environment_diff#

native environment_diff(values is %string:string, name is string) is %string:string

values without name.

native environment_name#

native environment_name(name is string) is string

name checked and normalized as the host spells variable names.

native environment_home#

native environment_home(values is %string:string) is string

The home directory values name.

native environment_path_separator#

native environment_path_separator() is string

: or ;.

native environment_get#

native environment_get(name is @byte) is @byte

Legacy raw mutation boundary. High-level std modules must not use it.

native environment_set#

native environment_set(name is @byte, value is @byte) is bool

Sets name to value in this process.

native environment_remove#

native environment_remove(name is @byte) is bool

Removes name from this process.

native environment_all#

native environment_all() is @@@byte

Every variable of this process, as name and value bytes.
